features.label: Mandatory claims without a current review
features.description: Share of mandatory claims whose recorded review basis is not current.

features.label: Required document categories without current reviewed validity
features.description: Template-required document types with no eligible reviewed document.

features.label: Days until the recorded application deadline
features.description: Clamped to 365 when no deadline is recorded; negative values are past due.

features.label: Application deadline recorded
features.description: 1 when the captured application has a deadline; 0 otherwise.

features.label: Continuing obligations overdue
features.description: Unfulfilled obligations whose due date is before the captured date.

features.label: Confirmed integrity signals
features.description: Integrity signals with a confirmed disposition.

features.label: Course scope review pending
features.description: 1 when the requested scope revision has no current acknowledgement.

features.label: Independent reviews needing a current basis
features.description: Mandatory case reviews that are incomplete or bound to stale evidence.

features.label: Documents past their stated expiry
features.description: Captured documents with an expiry date before the captured date.

features.label: Rejected document scans
features.description: Documents whose scan status is rejected.

features.label: Pending document scans
features.description: Documents whose scan status is pending.

features.label: Application age
features.description: Days from application creation to the captured date, clamped to 0..1200.

features.label: Workflow stage index
features.description: 0 submission, 1 scrutiny, 2 expert visit, 3 final decision, 4 outcome.

features.label: Expert visit required
features.description: 1 when the application requires an expert visit.

features.label: Captured documents
features.description: Number of documents attached to the captured case.

features.label: Captured claims
features.description: Number of requirement claims in the captured case.
